item.title: NI council looks at woodland and meadow sites for ‘green burials’
item.description: A Northern Ireland council is to examine the feasibility of providing sustainable burial grounds in the city, with a view to establishing sites for so-called green or “natural” burials. item.title: Met Office issues yellow weather warning for heavy rain across Northern Ireland

item.title: New suspected Bluetongue case detected as DAERA extends control measures
item.description: A new suspected case of Bluetongue has been identified on a farm near Greyabbey, prompting the Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs (DAERA) to impose a second 20km Temporary Control Zone (TCZ) in Co Down. The case was detected during routine surveillance testing within the existing TCZ, established on 29 November 2025 around a holding near Bangor where the Bluetongue BTV-3 virus was first discovered.
